captions.detailed: A lightweight mountain bike front suspension fork assembly featuring a flat handlebar, stem, upper crown, and telescoping legs. The upper crown, steerer tube, stem, and handlebar are finished in matte black, while the lower stanchion tubes are a contrasting metallic silver. The assembly features multiple articulating joints: the lower stanchions slide telescopically (prismatically) into the upper crown legs, the stem rotates around the steerer tube via a revolute joint, and the handlebar rotates within the stem clamp.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated mountain bike suspension fork with a flat handlebar and stem in CadQuery. Ensure the model includes telescoping lower stanchions (prismatic joints), a stem that rotates on the steerer tube (revolute joint), and a handlebar that rotates inside the stem clamp (revolute joint), using appropriate black and silver materials.
captions.factory: Construct the assembly using an ArticulatedObject builder. Model the upper crown using a box primitive, and the steerer tube, upper stanchions, stem clamp, and handlebar using cylinder primitives. Define separate parts for the upper crown (with upper stanchions and steerer), the individual lower stanchions (with axle mounts), the stem clamp, and the handlebar (with grips). Connect these parts using two prismatic joints for the telescoping fork legs, one revolute joint for the stem on the steerer, and one revolute joint for the handlebar inside the stem.
